{"title":"Zusammenstellung sozialwissenschaftlicher Daten und Studien zur Wahl der Volksvertretungen und der Regierungsbildung im Bund und in den Ländern der Bundesrepublik Deutschland 1946-1972","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA0583","justification":"This dataset compiles social science data and studies on elections and government formation in Germany up to 1972, covering political behavior and attitudes relevant to the 1970s."},
{"title":"Politische Einstellungen und Verhaltensweisen. Eine Umfrage der Tageszeitung 'Bild' (1971)","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA0123","justification":"This is a public opinion survey conducted in Germany in 1971 covering political attitudes and behaviors."},
{"title":"Bundestagswahl 1972 (German Federal Election Study 1972)","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA0640","justification":"This is a comprehensive study of the political behavior and attitudes of German citizens during the 1972 Federal election."},
{"title":"Wahlen und politisches Verhalten 1976 - Wahlstudie zur Bundestagswahl 1976","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA1160","justification":"Dataset covering voting and political behavior in Germany in relation to the 1976 Bundestag election."},
{"title":"Politische Einstellungen (ALLBUS 1977)","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA0705","justification":"The German General Social Survey 1977 includes questions about political attitudes and behavior during the 1970s."},
{"title":"Politische Einstellungen (ALLBUS 1978)","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA0819","justification":"The ALLBUS survey from 1978 provides data on political attitudes and behavior of German citizens."},
{"title":"Politische Einstellungen und politische Beteiligung 1973","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA0242","justification":"Public opinion survey on political attitudes and participation in Germany in 1973."},
{"title":"Politische Einstellungen und politische Beteiligung 1974","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA0243","justification":"Survey covering political attitudes and participation in Germany in 1974."},
{"title":"Bundestagswahl 1976: Parteivertrauen und politische Einstellungen","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA1161","justification":"This dataset includes study data from the 1976 election, focusing on trust in parties and political attitudes."},
{"title":"Jugend und politische Einstellungen 1977/1978","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA1103","justification":"This survey captures political attitudes among German youth during 1977/1978, reflecting political behavior in the late 1970s."}
]}
